firstQuestion.question: Is the training done in person or online?
firstQuestion.answer: We offer both in-person and online training, so you can choose the option that best suits your routine.

secondQuestion.question: Do I need to have experience with exercise to get started?
secondQuestion.answer: No! The workouts are fully adapted to your level, whether you're a beginner, intermediate, or advanced.

thirdQuestion.question: Do I need equipment to train at home?
thirdQuestion.answer: Not necessarily. Workouts can be done using your body weight or simple equipment. If you have dumbbells, resistance bands, or other accessories, we can include them in your routine.

fourthQuestion.question: How do I contact support?
fourthQuestion.answer: If you need help with our platform or have any other questions, please contact the company's support team by submitting a support request through the website or sending an email to support@ourwebsite.com.

fifthQuestion.question: Can I get a refund for my subscription?
fifthQuestion.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for most of our subscription plans. If you are not satisfied with your subscription within the first 30 days, you can request a full refund. Refunds for subscriptions active for more than 30 days may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
